crossRefs.note: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up…
I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
“Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all…
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength…
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will…
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

parallels.note: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

translations.web: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
translations.bsb: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

translations.asv: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.
